criteria: INSERT Warehouse.VehicleTemperatures reads $.Recordings; properties rego/sensor/when/temp map to registration/sensor/time/temperature, full element '$' AS JSON is stored with IsCompressed=0 and compressed data NULL.
ISJSON=0 throws 51000 with state 1 before BEGIN TRY/TRAN; zero inserted rows only prints warnings then reaches COMMIT.

CATCH prints help then throws 51000 with state 2, so following IF XACT_STATE rollback and RETURN 1 are not executed on that path; RETURN after the early THROW is also unreachable. State is not severity; runtime transaction outcome depends on engine/error/ambient state.
